import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Check for stratified association
    strata_assoc = []
    for stratum in set(feats.stratum):
        mask = np.array(feats.stratum) == stratum
        y_stratum = feats.y[mask]
        if len(np.unique(y_stratum)) < 2:
            continue
        x_stratum = feats.x[mask]
        # Compute effect size per feature
        effects = []
        for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
            if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
                continue  # Skip clinical features for this test
            x_col = x_stratum[:, feats.column(fid)]
            # Use t-test to measure association
            y0 = x_col[y_stratum == 0]
            y1 = x_col[y_stratum == 1]
            if len(y0) > 0 and len(y1) > 0:
                t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(y0, y1, equal_var=False)
                effects.append((abs(t_stat), fid))
            else:
                effects.append((0, fid))
        strata_assoc.append(sorted(effects, reverse=True))
    
    # If no strong associations in any stratum, return empty design
    if not strata_assoc:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
        
    # Aggregate effects across strata
    agg_effects = defaultdict(list)
    for effects in strata_assoc:
        for effect, fid in effects:
            agg_effects[fid].append(effect)
    
    # Compute average effect size
    avg_effects = [(np.mean(agg_effects[fid]), fid) for fid in agg_effects]
    avg_effects.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features by effect size
    candidates = [fid for _, fid in avg_effects[:10]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    selected = []
    for fid in candidates:
        is_duplicate = False
        for sel_fid in selected:
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)], 
                               feats.x[:, feats.column(sel_fid)])[0,1]) > 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
        if not is_duplicate:
            selected.append(fid)
    
    # Fit logistic regression with selected features
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in selected]]
    model = LogisticRegression(penalty='l1', solver='liblinear')
    model.fit(X, feats.y)
    
    # Get coefficients
    coefs = model.coef_[0]
    
    # Identify significant drivers (non-zero coefficients)
    drivers = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(selected):
        if abs(coefs[i]) > 1e-6:
            drivers.append((abs(coefs[i]), fid))
    
    # Sort by coefficient magnitude
    drivers.sort(reverse=True)
    drivers = [fid for _, fid in drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Return design with drivers, columns, products, and loadings
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple([d for d in drivers if d in feats.ids]),
        columns=tuple(selected),
        products=(),
        loadings={}
    )
